title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Community Service Participation by Age Group
prompt: The pie chart below shows the percentage distribution of volunteers across five age groups in a community service programme in a town called Greenfield in 2023. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为雅思学术类写作 Task 1 练习。请根据所给饼图，总结主要特征并进行比较。注意：所有场景和数据均为模拟，并非官方雅思试卷。写作时请确保字数不少于150词，不要表达个人观点或解释原因。
